idea: Feelings & kindness (AVA'S ROOM): Baby Ava's soft white bunny plush sits on a high wall shelf and she can't reach it ('Oh no! My bunny is up so high!'); she presses her hands together and asks 'Mommy, please! Help me, please!' (copy-me: hands together, say please); Mommy Lily gets it and Ava hugs her bunny: 'Thank you, Mommy! Thank you!'; chorus 'Please and thank you!'; Mommy offers a red apple and Ava asks the viewer 'What do we say? Hmm?' (pause) – 'Thank you!'; lesson 'Please and thank you, kind little words!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now the shelf is empty, bunny in her arm, bye-bye wave.
lesson: Say 'please' when you ask and 'thank you' when you get something – kind little words.
calendar: Tuesday slot 2 – Feelings & kindness (please / thank you). Tue slot 2 may add ONE grown-up: Mommy Lily.

variety.outfit: Ava HOME (yellow dress, matches the sheet); Mommy Lily HOME
variety.note: first video ever in Ava's room; the bunny plush is part of the fixed room block

characters: Ava (HOME): BABY AVA: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby girl with short fluffy curly brown hair, one small curly ponytail on top with a sparkly pink star hair clip, big brown eyes, rosy cheeks. wearing a soft yellow dress with ruffle sleeves and a small pink flower, and pink baby shoes with bows.

Mommy Lily (HOME): MOMMY: a kind young mother in 3D Pixar style, blonde hair in a messy high bun with loose curly strands around her face, big bright blue eyes, rosy cheeks, gentle sweet smile. wearing a loose soft coral oversized short-sleeve t-shirt, light blue wide-leg loose jeans, white sneakers and small gold hoop earrings.

supporting_objects.bunny: Ava's soft white bunny plush (long floppy ears, pink inner ears) – from the AVA'S ROOM block
supporting_objects.apple: one shiny red apple on Mommy's open palm

setting: AVA'S ROOM: a sweet baby girl's bedroom with soft pink walls painted with white clouds and little flowers, yellow curtains with flower tie-backs, a white toddler bed with a yellow flower blanket and a small pink star pillow, a butterfly mobile, a pink toy box with white flowers, a soft white bunny plush, a small dollhouse and a fluffy flower-shaped rug.

learning.goal: Use the kind words 'please' (when asking) and 'thank you' (when receiving).
learning.shown_how: Ava presses her palms together and asks Mommy 'please' (bunny still on the high shelf); then hugs the bunny and says 'thank you'; then Mommy offers an apple and the viewer is asked what to say.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:18-0:21 'A yummy apple! What do we say? Hmm?' (finger on chin, question boing) + 0:21-0:23 humming pause → 0:23 'Thank you! Thank you, Mommy! Yay!' (Ava claps)
learning.copy_me: 0:03-0:07 'Hands together, say please!' – kids press their palms together like Ava
learning.fact_check: please used for asking, thank you for receiving (correct usage); exactly one bunny and one apple on screen; bunny on the shelf in shots 1-2, in Ava's arms / on the toy box from shot 3 on; apple only from shot 4.
learning.modeling: Ava asks politely instead of grabbing or crying, and thanks Mommy right away; Mommy models warm kindness.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, everyday situation, calm pink room, one baby + Mommy, big faces, nothing scary.

fun_mechanics: interactive pause: What do we say?

story_order.bunny: shots 1-2 on the high shelf (out of reach) · shot 3 in Ava's arms · shot 4 on the toy box · shot 5 in her arm, shelf empty
story_order.apple: shots 1-3 absent · shot 4 appears on Mommy's palm · shot 5 absent (not needed in the loop)

c1_note: C1 content-rejected 5 motion prompts written in the usual long 'BABY AVA ... never turns around, nothing passes in front of her face' style for the close-up frames (no charge); the same frames were accepted with short plain prompts ('The cartoon girl character with curly BROWN hair, a PINK STAR CLIP and BIG BROWN EYES ...').
